vectors.description: draft-mzanaty-moq-loc-05 2.3 declares an even type's value as Length bytes, but its [MoQTransport], draft-ietf-moq-transport-10 9.1.1.2, frames an even type's value as one varint. Capture Timestamp (2.3.1.1) declares 8 bytes, a 64-bit big-endian integer; the varint 1746104606044000 cannot be that, so the value is left uninterpreted.
